captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a modern, rectangular home air purifier with a clean, light-gray appliance body. It features a top control panel with a prominent cylindrical grey dial, colored indicator lights, and a black exhaust vent. The sides host dark, perforated intake grilles, while the front has a rectangular filter door with horizontal vents and an integrated handle. The filter door is designed to articulate, swinging open on a vertical hinge on its left side to simulate access to the internal filter.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a realistic home air purifier using CadQuery. The design must feature a light-gray rectangular main body, side intake grilles with perforated patterns, a top control panel with a rotatable dial, and a front filter access door that articulates on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main body as a filleted box with subtracted cavities for side vents, top controls, and the front door. Populate the side vents with a grid of small cylinders subtracted from a thin panel. Build the top panel with a cylindrical dial, small colored spheres for indicator LEDs, and a slatted exhaust grille created by arraying thin boxes. Construct the front filter door with a frame, horizontal vent slots, and a handle, then define a revolute articulation joint along its left edge to allow it to swing open.
